# Video Downloader for MyGo

Video Downloader for MyGo is a native Go desktop application for downloading and converting media through yt-dlp and FFmpeg. It is a rewrite of https://github.com/fazi-gondal/Video-Downloader.

## Stack

- Go 1.27.1.
- MyGo v0.4.8, pinned as `tool github.com/egoist/mygo/cmd/mygo` in `go.mod`.
- Native MyGo UI; no web frontend or Bun build.
- yt-dlp for extraction/downloads.
- FFmpeg and FFprobe for merge, remux, subtitle embedding, conversion, and probing.

## Run and verify

```bash
```

Use `go tool mygo dev` for live development. Use `go tool mygo build -platform windows/amd64` or `linux/amd64` for packaging. Set `CGO_ENABLED=0` for reproducible native builds.

## Main behavior

- Home analyzes a video or playlist URL.
- Single-video results show a thumbnail and lead to download configuration.
- Playlists provide entry selection and batch queueing.
- Multiple audio tracks and any embedded subtitles force MKV in the UI and request.
- Subtitle custom lists contain available languages and retain language codes internally.
- Subtitle-only HTTP 429 failures are shown as warnings when media succeeds.
- Downloads show thumbnails, status, progress, downloaded/total bytes, speed, and ETA.
- Converter supports drag/drop, native file picking, remux where safe, and FFmpeg re-encoding.
- History is persisted as JSON and supports search, filters, re-download, deletion, and opening output folders.

## Configuration

Settings are stored under the platform application directory in `settings.json`. Fields include download directory, worker count, fragment concurrency, proxy, cookies browser, custom headers, rate limit, subtitle defaults, multi-audio defaults, thumbnail/metadata embedding, VP9 preference, keep-originals, and theme mode.

See `README.md` for the complete field table and `BUILD.md` for packaging.

## Resources

Bundled helpers are downloaded into `resources/<platform>/bin` by `scripts/fetch-tools.sh`. The script is Bash-specific and must be run with Bash. Downloaded binaries are ignored by Git.

## Source map

- `internal/app`: UI shell, pages, thumbnails, settings/about views.
- `internal/models`: media, download, and conversion state.
- `internal/services/ytdlp.go`: yt-dlp arguments, parsing, downloads.
- `internal/services/download_manager.go`: worker queue and events.
- `internal/services/ffmpeg.go`: conversion and probing.
- `internal/services/history.go`: JSON history persistence.
- `internal/tools/resolve.go`: bundled/PATH executable resolution.
- `internal/ui`: theme and embedded SVG icons.
